definition_zh: 名词：烤架；烧烤聚会；烤肉。动词：用烤架烤（肉或鱼）
definition_en: a metal frame or gas grill for cooking food over fire; an outdoor meal cooked this way; the meat itself; to cook food on such a grill
core_image: 炭火上支着一张铁架，肉在上面滋滋冒油
scene: 周末后院飘起炭火味，邻居把腌好的肉端了过来。We lit the barbecue and waited for the coals to turn grey.
sceneCN: 这里 barbecue 是「烤架」（第 1 个义项：架在火上烤肉的器具）；句意是我们点起烤架，等炭火转成灰白。

pos.zh: 名词：烤架；烧烤聚会；烤肉

senses.title: The grill itself
senses.definition: a metal frame or gas device for cooking food over an open fire
senses.definitionCN: 架在明火上烤食物的金属架或燃气器具
senses.example: We lit the barbecue and waited for the coals to turn grey.
senses.exampleCN: 我们点起烤架，等炭火转成灰白。
senses.why: The Taino barbacoa was a raised wooden frame; English kept the frame sense when the frame became metal.
senses.whyCN: 泰诺语 barbacoa 本指架高的木台；英语保留了「架子」这一义，只是木架换成了铁架。

senses.title: The outdoor meal
senses.definition: an outdoor party where food is cooked and eaten over a fire
senses.definitionCN: 在户外生火烤肉并一起吃的聚会
senses.example: They invited us to a backyard barbecue on Sunday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们邀我们周日去后院烧烤。
senses.why: Cooking a whole animal outdoors became a social event, so the apparatus lent its name to the gathering.
senses.whyCN: 在户外烤整只牲畜成了社交活动，于是器具之名转指聚会本身。

senses.title: The meat on the plate
senses.definition: meat, especially pork or beef, slow-cooked over smoke in the American South
senses.definitionCN: 肉，尤指美国南部以烟慢烤的猪肉或牛肉
senses.example: The barbecue was tender enough to pull apart with a fork.
senses.exampleCN: 这份烤肉嫩得能用叉子撕开。
senses.why: In the American South the word narrowed from the event to the smoked meat served at it.
senses.whyCN: 在美国南部，词义从「聚会」收窄为席上那块烟熏肉。

senses.title: To cook on the grill
senses.definition: to cook meat or fish over an open fire or hot coals
senses.definitionCN: 在明火或热炭上烤（肉或鱼）
senses.example: She barbecued the chicken with a honey glaze.
senses.exampleCN: 她给鸡刷上蜂蜜汁再烤。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb with no added ending, as English often does with cooking words.
senses.whyCN: 名词不加词尾直接转为动词，这是英语烹饪词的常见做法。

senses.title: The Australian barbie
senses.definition: in Australian and New Zealand speech, a clipped form naming the outdoor grill
senses.definitionCN: 澳新口语中的缩略说法，指户外烤炉
senses.example: Put another steak on the barbie before the rain starts.
senses.exampleCN: 趁雨还没下，再往烤炉上放块牛排。
senses.why: Australian English clips long words and adds -ie, giving barbie from barbecue.
senses.whyCN: 澳洲英语爱把长词截短再加 -ie，barbecue 于是成了 barbie。

intro.en: Barbecue began as a Caribbean wooden frame and ended as a backyard party.
intro.cn: barbecue 起于加勒比的一张木架，终于后院的一场聚会。

items.en: Taino speakers in the Caribbean used barbacoa for a raised wooden frame that smoked or dried meat.
items.cn: 加勒比泰诺人用 barbacoa 指一种架高的木台，用来熏肉或晾干肉。

items.en: Spanish took the word as barbacoa; Oviedo recorded it in his account of the Indies in 1526.
items.cn: 西班牙语借入为 barbacoa；奥维耶多在 1526 年的西印度群岛记述中已记录此词。

items.en: English borrowed it as barbecue, first for the frame and then for a whole animal roasted on it.
items.cn: 英语借入为 barbecue，先指木架，再指架上烤的整只牲畜。

items.en: Pit-cooking whole hogs outdoors turned the word into a regional food and a social event.
items.cn: 美国南部露天坑烤整猪，使这个词变成一种地方食物与一场社交活动。

items.en: Australian and New Zealand English clipped it to barbie for the backyard grill.
items.cn: 澳新英语把它截短为 barbie，专指后院烤炉。

items.en: Today barbecue is a noun, a verb and the name of the grill itself.
items.cn: 今天 barbecue 既是名词、动词，也是烤炉本身的名字。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bar- opening; the near-meaning group gives other words for cooking over fire.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar- 开头；近义组是其他「明火烹饪」的词。

normalIntro.en: Barbecue travels from a Caribbean frame to a backyard party, and the spelling hides a Taino word.
normalIntro.cn: barbecue 从加勒比的木架走到后院聚会，拼写里藏着一个泰诺词。

normal.en: The opening bar- is shared with barber and barbell, but the source is Taino barbacoa.
normal.cn: 开头 bar- 与 barber、barbell 相同，但词源是泰诺语 barbacoa。

normal.en: The noun came first: a frame, then a meal, then the meat on the plate.

sensesIntro.en: A frame, a party, a plate of meat and the act of grilling all share one word.

intro.en: Barbecue is a Taino loan, so its English family grows by suffixes: -s, -ed, -ing, -er and the clipping -ie.
intro.cn: barbecue 是泰诺语借词，其英语词族靠后缀生长：-s、-ed、-ing、-er，以及截短用的 -ie。

latinIntro.en: The root is Caribbean, not Latin, so this family sits outside the classical affix system.
latinIntro.cn: 词根来自加勒比而非拉丁语，因此这个词族不属于古典构词系统。

definition_zh: 赤裸的；光秃的；勉强的；露出
definition_en: not covered by clothes or anything else, or only just enough
core_image: 冬天的树枝光秃秃地伸向天空
scene: 雪化了，院子里一片安静。The trees stood bare against the sky.
sceneCN: 这里 bare 是「光秃的」（第 2 个义项：没有叶子或覆盖物）；句意是树木光秃秃地立在天空下。

pos.zh: 形容词：赤裸的；光秃的；勉强的

derivatives.zh: 由 bare 加 -ly 构成，义为「几乎不；仅仅」
由 bare 加 -ness 构成，义为「赤裸；荒芜」

senses.title: Not covered
senses.definition: not covered by clothes or a covering
senses.definitionCN: 没有被衣服或覆盖物遮住的
senses.example: He walked on the sand in bare feet.
senses.exampleCN: 他赤脚走在沙滩上。
senses.why: Bare is an old English word for 'uncovered', and the body is its most direct subject.
senses.whyCN: bare 是古英语中表示「没有遮盖」的词，身体是它最直接的对象。

senses.title: Empty or leafless
senses.definition: without leaves, furniture or other usual covering
senses.definitionCN: 没有叶子、家具或其他常见覆盖物
senses.example: The trees stood bare against the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 树木光秃秃地立在天空下。
senses.why: A surface with nothing on it is uncovered in the same way as skin, so bare describes empty branches and rooms.
senses.whyCN: 表面什么都没有，和皮肤没被遮住是同样的「空」，所以 bare 也形容光秃的树枝与空荡的房间。

senses.title: Only just enough
senses.definition: no more than the minimum needed
senses.definitionCN: 不超过所需的最低限度
senses.example: They had the bare minimum of food.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的食物仅够最低需要。
senses.why: If nothing extra covers a thing, only the essential remains, which produced the sense of a bare minimum.
senses.whyCN: 如果没有多余的东西覆盖，剩下的就只有必需部分，于是产生「最低限度」的义项。

definition_zh: 几乎不；仅仅；勉强
definition_en: only just, or almost not
core_image: 一只手刚够到架子最边沿的杯子
scene: 灯突然灭了，屋里一片黑。I could barely see the road ahead.
sceneCN: 这里 barely 是「几乎不」（第 1 个义项：表示程度极低，差一点就不能）；句意是我几乎看不清前面的路。

senses.title: Almost not
senses.definition: only just, in a way that is almost not true
senses.definitionCN: 只差一点就不能，程度极低
senses.example: I could barely see the road ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 我几乎看不清前面的路。
senses.why: Barely is bare plus -ly, and bare means 'nothing extra', so barely marks a point with nothing to spare.
senses.whyCN: barely 是 bare 加 -ly，而 bare 意为「没有多余」，所以 barely 标记的是毫无余量的那一点。

senses.title: Only just
senses.definition: by only a small amount or margin
senses.definitionCN: 只差很小的量或幅度
senses.example: We had barely enough money for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的钱勉强够坐公交。
senses.why: When a supply has no surplus, just enough is barely enough, which gives the sense of a narrow margin.
senses.whyCN: 当供给没有剩余时，刚好够就等于勉强够，于是产生「只差一点」的含义。

definition_zh: 便宜货；协议；讨价还价
definition_en: something bought for less than the usual price, an agreement, or to argue about a price
core_image: 摊位上贴着打折标签的一只旧木箱
scene: 周末的集市人声嘈杂。She found a warm coat at a bargain price.
sceneCN: 这里 bargain 是「便宜货」（第 1 个义项：以低于常价买到的物品）；句意是她以很便宜的价格买到一件暖和的外套。

senses.title: Something cheap
senses.definition: something bought for less than its usual price
senses.definitionCN: 以低于平常价格买到的东西
senses.example: She found a warm coat at a bargain price.
senses.exampleCN: 她以很便宜的价格买到一件暖和的外套。
senses.why: A bargain first meant a deal struck after haggling, and a good deal is one bought cheaply.
senses.whyCN: bargain 起初指讨价还价后达成的交易，划算的交易就是买得便宜的东西。

senses.title: An agreement
senses.definition: an agreement between two sides about what each will do
senses.definitionCN: 双方就各自要做的事达成的约定
senses.example: They struck a bargain over the price.
senses.exampleCN: 他们就价格达成了协议。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the agreement itself, before the word came to praise a low price.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是协议本身，后来这个词才用来称赞低价。

senses.title: To haggle
senses.definition: to argue about a price until both sides agree
senses.definitionCN: 就价格争论直到双方同意
senses.example: He bargained with the seller for ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 他和卖家讨价还价了十分钟。
senses.why: The verb came from Old French bargaignier, to haggle, and names the talk that leads to the deal.
senses.whyCN: 动词来自古法语 bargaignier「讨价还价」，指促成交易的那番交谈。

abstract.cn: 想象集市摊位前围着一圈人。

examples.en: She found a warm coat at a bargain price.
examples.cn: 她以很便宜的价格买到一件暖和的外套。

examples.en: They struck a bargain over the price.
examples.cn: 他们就价格达成了协议。

examples.en: He bargained with the seller for ten minutes.
examples.cn: 他和卖家讨价还价了十分钟。

dict_mnemonic.text: bar-gain 像「把价往下压」：压下来的那部分，就是 bargain。

root: 来自古法语 bargaignier「讨价还价」，名词 barghaigne 意为「交易」；由协议义引申为「买到便宜货」，动词保留「议价」本义。

sensesIntro.en: The haggling, the agreement and the cheap buy are three stages of one deal.
sensesIntro.cn: 讨价还价、达成协议与买到便宜货，是同一笔交易的三个阶段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a price tag with a red slash.
core.cn: 核心意象：价签上划了一道红线。

intro.en: The -ing and -er endings give bargaining and bargainer.
intro.cn: 词尾 -ing 与 -er 构成 bargaining 与 bargainer。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the word came from Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词来自古法语。

definition_en: a long flat-bottomed boat for carrying freight; to push or move in a rough clumsy way; to intrude uninvited
core_image: 窄水道里一艘平底船硬挤过去，肩膀撞开人群
scene: 窄水道里两船相会，船工撑着篙慢慢错开。A coal barge moved slowly along the canal.
sceneCN: 这里 barge 是「驳船」（第 1 个义项：运河上运货的平底船）；句意是一艘运煤驳船沿着运河缓缓前行。

forms.label: 名词复数／动词第三人称单数

名词：驳船船工

senses.title: The flat-bottomed boat
senses.definition: a long flat-bottomed boat for carrying freight on canals and rivers
senses.definitionCN: 在运河与河流上运货的长形平底船
senses.example: A coal barge moved slowly along the canal.
senses.exampleCN: 一艘运煤驳船沿着运河缓缓前行。
senses.why: Old French barge named a flat boat; the canal age fixed the cargo sense.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 barge 指平底船；运河时代把「运货」这一义固定下来。

senses.title: The ceremonial boat
senses.definition: a large ornate boat used for state occasions or for pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 用于典礼或游乐的大型华丽船只
senses.example: The royal barge carried the queen down the river.
senses.exampleCN: 皇家礼宾船载着女王顺流而下。
senses.why: A barge is roomy and stable, so courts and cities kept one for display.
senses.whyCN: 驳船宽敞平稳，宫廷与城市便备一艘用于仪典。

senses.title: To push rudely
senses.definition: to move or push in a rough, clumsy way
senses.definitionCN: 粗鲁笨拙地移动或推挤
senses.example: He barged past the queue without apologising.
senses.exampleCN: 他连声抱歉都没有就硬挤过排队的人群。
senses.why: A barge cannot steer neatly in a narrow channel; the verb borrows that clumsy push.
senses.whyCN: 驳船在窄水道里无法灵巧转向；动词借用了那种笨拙的冲撞。

senses.title: Barge in
senses.definition: to enter or interrupt without being asked or welcome
senses.definitionCN: 未经邀请或不受欢迎地进入或打断
senses.example: She barged in while we were still arguing.
senses.exampleCN: 我们还在争论时她闯了进来。
senses.why: The boat pushes into a space too small for it, exactly as an unwelcome person does.
senses.whyCN: 船硬挤进太窄的空间，正如不受欢迎的人硬挤进来。

senses.title: Barge pole
senses.definition: the long pole used to push a barge; in the idiom, something one refuses to touch
senses.definitionCN: 撑驳船用的长篙；习语中指绝不愿碰的东西
senses.example: I would not touch that deal with a barge pole.
senses.exampleCN: 那笔交易我碰都不愿碰。
senses.why: The pole is long and dirty, so refusing to touch something with it means total avoidance.
senses.whyCN: 篙又长又脏，「用篙都不愿碰」就是彻底回避。

intro.en: Barge comes from a Latin word for a small boat, then learns to push.
intro.cn: barge 出自拉丁语「小船」一词，后来学会了硬挤。

items.en: Late Latin barca meant a small boat, the source of bark and barge alike.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 barca 意为小船，是 bark 与 barge 的共同源头。

items.en: An assumed form barga carried the word into the Romance languages.
items.cn: 拟构形式 barga 把这个词带进罗曼语族。

items.en: Old French barge named a flat-bottomed boat.
items.cn: 古法语 barge 指平底船。

items.en: English took barge for a small vessel, later a freight boat.
items.cn: 英语借入 barge，先指小船，后指货船。

items.en: Horse-drawn barges carried coal and grain through the new canals.
items.cn: 马拉驳船沿新开的运河运送煤与谷物。

items.en: The verb phrase barge in appeared for pushing rudely into a place or a talk.
items.cn: 动词短语 barge in 出现，指粗鲁地挤进某处或打断谈话。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bar- or the -ge ending; the near-meaning group gives flat boats and rough pushes.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar- 或 -ge 结尾；近义组是平底船与粗鲁推挤的词。

normalIntro.en: Barge moves from a slow flat boat to a rude push, because both force their way through a narrow space.
normalIntro.cn: barge 从缓慢的平底船走到粗鲁的推挤，因为两者都在窄空间里硬闯。

normal.en: Barge and barque share Latin barca, a small boat.
normal.cn: barge 与 barque 同出拉丁语 barca「小船」。

normal.en: The noun is the boat; the verb is the clumsy push.
normal.cn: 名词是船，动词是笨拙的冲撞。

normal.en: Barge in means to enter or interrupt without invitation.
normal.cn: barge in 指未经邀请就进入或打断。

normal.en: A barge pole is long, so not touching something with one means total refusal.
normal.cn: barge pole 很长，「用篙都不碰」就是彻底拒绝。

normal.en: The agent suffix -ee gives bargee, a barge worker.
normal.cn: 施事后缀 -ee 构成 bargee，指驳船船员。

abstract.en: See a flat boat loaded with coal, hauled by a horse on the towpath.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘装满煤的平底船，由岸上马拉着走。

abstract.en: See a shoulder push through a doorway before anyone steps aside.
abstract.cn: 想象一个肩膀在没人让路时就挤进门。

abstract.en: See a long dirty pole held out to keep a thing at a distance.
abstract.cn: 想象一根又长又脏的篙伸出去，把东西挡在远处。

examples.en: A coal barge moved slowly along the canal.
examples.cn: 一艘运煤驳船沿着运河缓缓前行。

examples.en: He barged past the queue without apologising.
examples.cn: 他连声抱歉都没有就硬挤过排队的人群。

examples.en: I would not touch that deal with a barge pole.
examples.cn: 那笔交易我碰都不愿碰。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扒挤」——驳船在窄水道里「扒」着岸、「挤」着走；人 barge in 也是这样硬挤进来，记住「船笨、人莽」两层意思。

root: 源自晚期拉丁语 barca「小船」，经古法语 barge 进入英语；本指平底货船，因船体笨重、在窄水道里横冲直撞，引申为动词「猛撞、粗鲁地挤入」，再派生出 barge in 与 barge pole。

sensesIntro.en: A boat, a royal procession, a rude push and a long pole all answer to barge.
sensesIntro.cn: 一条船、一场皇家仪典、一次粗鲁的推挤和一根长篙，都叫 barge。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat boat forcing its way down a narrow channel.
core.cn: 核心意象：平底船在窄水道里硬挤着往前走。

intro.en: Barge builds its family with -s, -ed, -ing and the agent endings -ee and -man.
intro.cn: barge 用 -s、-ed、-ing 以及施事后缀 -ee、-man 构成词族。

latinIntro.en: The root is Latin barca, a small boat, which also gave English bark and barque.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 barca「小船」，它也给出了英语的 bark 与 barque。

definition_zh: 名词：男中音（介于男高音与男低音之间）；男中音歌手；上低音号等中音乐器。形容词：男中音的
definition_en: the male voice between tenor and bass; a singer of that range; an instrument of that register; of or for that range
core_image: 合唱团里站在高音与低音之间的那一排嗓子
scene: 合唱团排练到一半，指挥单独点了中间那一排。The baritone held the middle line between tenor and bass.
sceneCN: 这里 baritone 是「男中音」（第 1 个义项：介于男高音与男低音之间的声部）；句意是男中音撑住了两者之间的那条中线。

pos.zh: 名词：男中音；男中音歌手；中音乐器
形容词：男中音的；中音的

derivatives.zh: 名词：男中音，异体拼写
名词：巴里通琴（古乐器）
名词：男高音，相邻声部
名词：男低音，相邻声部

senses.title: The middle male range
senses.definition: the male singing voice between tenor and bass
senses.definitionCN: 介于男高音与男低音之间的男声声部
senses.example: The baritone held the middle line between tenor and bass.
senses.exampleCN: 男中音撑住了男高音与男低音之间的那条中线。
senses.why: Greek barytonos meant deep-sounding; Italian applied it to the voice just above the bass.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 barytonos 意为「声音低沉」；意大利语用它指紧靠男低音之上的那个声部。

senses.title: The singer
senses.definition: a man who sings in that range
senses.definitionCN: 以该音域演唱的男歌手
senses.example: The baritone stepped forward for the solo.
senses.exampleCN: 那位男中音上前一步唱独唱段。
senses.why: The range name transferred to the person who owns it, as with tenor and bass.
senses.whyCN: 音域名转指拥有它的人，与 tenor、bass 同理。

senses.title: The brass instrument
senses.definition: a valved brass instrument of that register, the baritone horn
senses.definitionCN: 该音域的铜管乐器，即上低音号
senses.example: He plays baritone in the brass band.
senses.exampleCN: 他在铜管乐队里吹上低音号。
senses.why: Bands named each horn after the voice it matched.
senses.whyCN: 乐队按对应的人声声部给每件铜管乐器命名。

senses.title: Extended-register instruments
senses.definition: instruments built lower than the standard member of their family
senses.definitionCN: 音域低于同族标准成员的乐器
senses.example: The baritone saxophone growled under the trumpets.
senses.exampleCN: 中音萨克斯在小号之下低吼。
senses.why: The voice word was reused for any instrument sitting in the same low-middle slot.
senses.whyCN: 这个声部词被借去指任何落在同一中低音位置的乐器。

senses.title: As an adjective
senses.titleCN: 形容词：男中音的；中音的
senses.definition: of, for or written in that range
senses.definitionCN: 属于、用于或写在该音域的
senses.example: The part is written in baritone clef.
senses.exampleCN: 这个声部用中音谱号记谱。
senses.why: English lets the noun act as an adjective with no ending added.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许名词不加词尾直接作形容词。

intro.en: Baritone is literally heavy tone, a Greek compound that Italian turned into a voice name.
intro.cn: baritone 字面就是「重音」，一个希腊复合词被意大利语变成了声部名。

items.en: The root gwere- meant heavy and gave Greek barys.
items.cn: 词根 gwere- 意为「重」，衍生出希腊语 barys。

items.en: Barys meant heavy or deep, the first half of the compound.
items.cn: barys 意为「重的、低沉的」，是复合词的前半。

items.en: Tonos meant a stretching, then a pitch or tone.
items.cn: tonos 本义「拉紧」，后指音高、音调。

items.en: Barytonos combined the two into deep-sounding.
items.cn: barytonos 把两者合成「声音低沉的」。

items.en: Italian baritono named the male voice above the bass.
items.cn: 意大利语 baritono 指男低音之上的男声声部。

items.en: English took the word for the voice, then for instruments of that register.
items.cn: 英语借入指声部，后又指同音域的乐器。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bary- or bar-; the near-meaning group lists the neighbouring voice registers.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bary- 或 bar-；近义组列出相邻的人声声部。

normalIntro.en: Baritone is heavy tone: bary- means heavy and -tone means pitch, so the voice sits low but not lowest.
normalIntro.cn: baritone 就是「重音」：bary- 意为重，-tone 意为音高，所以这个声部低，但不是最低。

normal.en: Bary- is the same heavy root as in baryon and barium.
normal.cn: bary- 与 baryon、barium 中的「重」根相同。

normal.en: -tone comes from Greek tonos, a stretched pitch.
normal.cn: -tone 出自希腊语 tonos「拉紧的音高」。

normal.en: From high to low the male voices run tenor, baritone, bass.
normal.cn: 男声从高到低是 tenor、baritone、bass。

normal.en: The baritone horn and baritone saxophone both sit in that middle-low slot.
normal.cn: 上低音号与中音萨克斯都落在中低音位置。

normal.en: Barytone is an older spelling of the same word.
normal.cn: barytone 是同一个词的旧拼写。

abstract.en: See a heavy weight resting on a stretched string.
abstract.cn: 想象一个重物压在拉紧的弦上。

abstract.en: See a singer standing between the high and low rows of a choir.
abstract.cn: 想象一位歌手站在合唱团高声部与低声部之间。

abstract.en: See a brass horn sounding lower than a trumpet but higher than a tuba.
abstract.cn: 想象一支铜管号，音比小号低、比大号高。

examples.en: The baritone held the middle line between tenor and bass.
examples.cn: 男中音撑住了男高音与男低音之间的那条中线。

examples.en: He plays baritone in the brass band.
examples.cn: 他在铜管乐队里吹上低音号。

examples.en: The baritone saxophone growled under the trumpets.
examples.cn: 中音萨克斯在小号之下低吼。

dict_mnemonic.text: bary-（重）＋ tone（音）＝「重音」：比 tenor 沉、比 bass 亮，正好卡在中间，就是男中音。

root: 源自希腊语 barytonos「声音低沉的」，由 barys「重的」加 tonos「音高」构成，经意大利语 baritono 进入英语；指介于男高音与男低音之间的男中音，后扩展指同音域的乐器。

sensesIntro.en: A voice, a singer, a brass horn and a saxophone can all be baritone.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个声部、一位歌手、一支铜管号和一支萨克斯，都可以是 baritone。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy weight resting on a stretched string.
core.cn: 核心意象：重物压在拉紧的弦上，声音低而不沉底。

intro.en: The Greek halves bary- and -tone build baritone, barytone and the heavier baryon.
intro.cn: 希腊语两半 bary- 与 -tone 构成 baritone、barytone，以及更「重」的 baryon。

latinIntro.en: Barys is the heavy root behind barium and barite, so the family crosses into chemistry.
latinIntro.cn: barys 是 barium 与 barite 背后的「重」根，因此这个词族跨进了化学。

definition_zh: 树皮；狗叫；厉声说
definition_en: the outer cover of a tree, or the short loud sound a dog makes
core_image: 老树干上裂开的粗糙树皮
scene: 院子里的狗突然竖起耳朵。A dog barked at the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 bark 是「狗叫」（第 2 个义项：狗发出的短促叫声）；句意是一只狗对着大门叫。

derivatives.zh: 由 bark 加 -ing 构成，义为「吠叫声」
由 bark 加 -er 构成，义为「吠叫的狗；招揽顾客的人」

senses.title: The cover of a tree
senses.definition: the rough outer layer of a tree
senses.definitionCN: 树木粗糙的外层
senses.example: The bark of the old tree was deeply cracked.
senses.exampleCN: 那棵老树的树皮裂得很深。
senses.why: This sense came from Old Norse borkr and is unrelated to the dog's sound.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自古诺斯语 borkr，与狗叫声毫无关系。

senses.title: A dog's sound
senses.definition: the short loud sound a dog makes
senses.definitionCN: 狗发出的短促而响亮的声音
senses.example: A dog barked at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 一只狗对着大门叫。
senses.why: The dog sense is imitative, shaped to echo the sharp sound itself.
senses.whyCN: 狗叫义是拟声的，读音就是在模仿那短促的声音。

senses.title: To speak sharply
senses.definition: to say something in a loud, sharp voice
senses.definitionCN: 用响亮而尖锐的嗓音说话
senses.example: The coach barked orders at the players.
senses.exampleCN: 教练冲着球员厉声下命令。
senses.why: A sharp voice sounds like a dog's bark, so the verb extended from animals to people.
senses.whyCN: 尖锐的嗓音像狗吠，于是动词从动物扩展到人。

intro.en: Bark has two separate origins, one for tree skin and one for the dog's cry.
intro.cn: bark 有两个互不相关的来源，一个指树皮，一个指狗叫。

items.en: both senses remain common.

senses.title: The cereal crop
senses.definition: a hardy cereal grass, Hordeum vulgare, grown for its grain
senses.definitionCN: 一种耐寒的禾谷作物，学名 Hordeum vulgare，为取麦粒而种
senses.example: The field of barley rippled in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 大麦田在风中起伏。
senses.why: Old English bærlic meant of barley; the adjective was re-cut as a noun in Middle English.

senses.title: Malt for brewing
senses.definition: the grain soaked and dried to make malt for beer and whisky
senses.definitionCN: 浸水发芽再烘干制成麦芽，用于啤酒与威士忌
senses.example: Malted barley gives the beer its body.

senses.why: Barley germinates easily, so brewers chose it over other grains.

senses.title: Pearl barley as food
senses.definition: the grain polished and used in soups and stews
senses.definitionCN: 磨去外层的麦粒，用于汤与炖菜
senses.example: Add pearl barley to the soup an hour before serving.

senses.title: Barley drinks
senses.definition: in barley water and barley wine, drinks made from the grain
senses.definitionCN: 用于 barley water 与 barley wine 等大麦饮品
senses.example: She cooled the barley water and added lemon.
senses.exampleCN: 她把大麦水放凉，再加柠檬。
senses.why: The grain names the drink, as wheat names wheat beer.
senses.whyCN: 谷物为饮品命名，正如小麦命名小麦啤酒。

intro.en: Barley is an Old English adjective that forgot it was an adjective.
intro.cn: barley 本是一个古英语形容词，后来忘了自己的词性。

items.en: The root bhares- meant barley and gave Latin far and Old English bere.
items.cn: 词根 bhares- 意为大麦，衍生出拉丁语 far 与古英语 bere。

items.en: The Germanic form bariz- carried the grain name north.
items.cn: 日耳曼语形式 bariz- 把这个谷物名带到北方。

items.en: Bere meant barley; barn is bere plus ern, a barley house.
items.cn: bere 意为大麦；barn 由 bere 加 ern「房屋」构成，本义「大麦屋」。

items.en: Bærlic added -lic to bere, meaning of barley.
items.cn: bærlic 在 bere 上加 -lic，意为「大麦的」。

items.en: The adjective was reanalysed as a noun, giving barley.
items.cn: 这个形容词被重新分析为名词，成为 barley。

items.en: Barley remains the brewing grain, malted into beer and whisky.
items.cn: barley 仍是酿造用谷物，制成麦芽后用于啤酒与威士忌。

definition_zh: 谷仓；牲口棚
definition_en: a large farm building for storing grain or animals
core_image: 红色木墙的大房子，门敞着一半
scene: 田里的麦子已经收完。The farmer stored the grain in the barn.
sceneCN: 这里 barn 是「谷仓」（第 1 个义项：农场里存放谷物的大建筑）；句意是农民把谷物存进了谷仓。

derivatives.zh: 由 barn 与 yard 构成，义为「谷仓旁的院子」
动词：巡回演出；四处拉票（barn + storm）

senses.title: A grain store
senses.definition: a large farm building used to store grain or hay
senses.definitionCN: 农场里存放谷物或干草的大建筑
senses.example: The farmer stored the grain in the barn.
senses.exampleCN: 农民把谷物存进了谷仓。
senses.why: Barn is an old compound of bere, barley, and ern, house, so it literally meant a barley house.
senses.whyCN: barn 是 bere「大麦」与 ern「房子」的古复合词，字面就是「大麦房」。

senses.title: An animal shelter
senses.definition: a farm building where animals are kept
senses.definitionCN: 农场里饲养牲畜的建筑
senses.example: The cows were led into the barn at dusk.

senses.why: Once grain and animals shared the same farm building, the word covered both uses.

definition_zh: 气压计；晴雨表；反映趋势的标志
definition_en: an instrument measuring air pressure; anything that reflects change or trends
core_image: 玻璃管里水银升降，替天空报信
scene: 船长老房间墙上挂着铜圈仪表，指针微微颤动。The barometer fell sharply before the storm.
sceneCN: 这里 barometer 指「气压计」（第 1 个义项：测气压的仪器）；句意：暴风雨前气压计骤降。

derivatives.zh: 气压的；气压计的（barometer + -ic）
气压测定法（barometer 替换后缀）
气压记录仪（baro- + -graph）

senses.title: The instrument
senses.definition: a device that measures atmospheric pressure
senses.definitionCN: 测量大气压强的仪器
senses.example: Torricelli's mercury barometer dates from 1643.
senses.exampleCN: 托里拆利的水银气压计发明于 1643 年。
senses.why: The name says it all: a weight-measurer of the air.
senses.whyCN: 名称自述：测量空气「重量」之器。

senses.title: Pressure reading as weather sign
senses.definition: the indication of coming weather from pressure change
senses.definitionCN: 由气压变化预示天气
senses.example: A falling barometer means rain is near.
senses.exampleCN: 气压下降意味着雨将至。
senses.why: Heavy air and light air play seesaw with weather.
senses.whyCN: 空气轻重与天气此起彼伏。

senses.title: Figurative indicator
senses.definition: something that reflects the state or trend of things
senses.definitionCN: 反映状况或趋势的事物
senses.example: House sales are a barometer of confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 房屋销量是信心的晴雨表。
senses.why: What rises and falls with another thing is its barometer.
senses.whyCN: 随之消长之物即为其晴雨表。

senses.title: In science and aviation
senses.definition: pressure measurement used for altitude and forecasting
senses.definitionCN: 用于测高与预报的气压测量
senses.example: Pilots set altimeters by barometric pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员按气压校准高度表。
senses.why: Pressure falls with height, so the instrument climbs mountains too.
senses.whyCN: 气压随高度下降，仪器便也可登山。

senses.title: Mercury type
senses.definition: a barometer using a column of mercury in a tube
senses.definitionCN: 用管中水银柱测量气压的气压计
senses.example: The lab keeps a standard mercury barometer.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室保存一支标准水银气压计。
senses.why: The heaviest handy liquid gives the shortest column.
senses.whyCN: 用最重的常用液体可得最短液柱。

senses.title: Aneroid type
senses.definition: a barometer using a sealed flexible metal box
senses.definitionCN: 用密封弹性金属盒感压的气压计
senses.example: The aneroid barometer fits in a pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 无液气压计可放入口袋。
senses.why: Without liquid, a squeezing box moves the needle.
senses.whyCN: 不用液体，靠受压的盒子拨动指针。

senses.title: Recording barograph
senses.definition: a barometer that draws a continuous pressure curve
senses.definitionCN: 自动描画连续气压曲线的气压计
senses.example: The barograph traced the storm all night.
senses.exampleCN: 记录仪整夜描出风暴曲线。
senses.why: A pen added to the aneroid turns reading into a story.
senses.whyCN: 在无液盒上加一支笔，读数变成叙事。

senses.title: Public-opinion usage
senses.definition: polls or media taken as measures of public feeling
senses.definitionCN: 作为民情度量的民调或媒体
senses.example: Elections are the clearest barometer of mood.
senses.exampleCN: 选举是民情最清楚的晴雨表。
senses.why: Societies read their pressure as weathermen read air.
senses.whyCN: 社会像气象员读空气那样读自己。

intro.en: Barometer was coined in the 1660s from Greek baros, weight, and metron, measure: a measurer of the weight of the air.
intro.cn: barometer 造于十七世纪六十年代，由希腊语 baros「重量」加 metron「测量」构成：测量空气重量之器。

items.en: The root bher- meant to carry, hence weight.
items.cn: 词根 bher- 意为「承载」，引出「重量」。

items.en: baros meant weight or heaviness.
items.cn: 希腊语 baros 指重量、沉重。

items.en: metron meant measure; both parts joined in scientific Greek.
items.cn: metron 指度量；两部分在科学希腊语中合成。

items.en: The word was coined soon after Torricelli's experiment became known.
items.cn: 托里拆利实验广为人知后，该词随即造出。

items.en: The figurative sense spread in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 比喻义于十九世纪流行。

senses.title: The lowest peer
senses.definition: the lowest hereditary rank of the British peerage
senses.definitionCN: 英国贵族中最低的世袭爵位
senses.example: The baron took his seat at the far end of the chamber.
senses.exampleCN: 男爵在议事厅最末一端就座。
senses.why: Old French baron named a nobleman; English fixed it as the bottom rung of the peerage.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 baron 指贵族；英语把它定为贵族阶梯的最下一级。

senses.title: The feudal lord
senses.definition: a medieval lord holding land directly from the king
senses.definitionCN: 中世纪直接从国王手中领有土地的领主
senses.example: The baron owned half the valley and every mill in it.

senses.why: The first barons were the king's tenants-in-chief, so the word meant land and power together.

senses.title: The magnate

senses.definitionCN: 主宰某个行业的人，如石油大亨或传媒巨头
senses.example: The oil baron bought the railway to move his own crude.
senses.exampleCN: 那位石油大亨买下铁路来运自己的原油。
senses.why: A magnate rules a trade as a lord ruled a valley, so the title transferred.
senses.whyCN: 大亨主宰行业，正如领主主宰山谷，于是爵位名转用。

senses.title: The modern life peer
senses.definition: a life peer created Baron or Baroness for public service
senses.definitionCN: 因公共服务受封为男爵或女男爵的终身贵族
senses.example: She was created a baroness and sat as Baron Smith.
senses.exampleCN: 她受封为女男爵，以史密斯男爵身份就座。
senses.why: Britain still creates life peers, keeping the feudal word for a modern honour.
senses.whyCN: 英国仍册封终身贵族，让封建旧词承载现代荣誉。

senses.title: Robber baron
senses.definition: a medieval lord who taxed every passing boat, or a ruthless modern industrialist
senses.definitionCN: 对每艘过路船征税的中世纪领主，或手段狠辣的现代工业家
senses.example: The robber baron charged a toll at every bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 那位强盗贵族在每座桥都设卡收税。
senses.why: The phrase moved from Rhine toll-takers to American industrialists of the 1870s.
senses.whyCN: 这个说法从莱茵河收税领主转指 1870 年代的美国工业家。

intro.en: Baron began as a free warrior and ended as an oil magnate.
intro.cn: baron 起于一名自由战士，终于一位石油大亨。

items.en: A Germanic baro, a free man or warrior, is the likely source.
items.cn: 日耳曼语 baro「自由人、战士」很可能是词源。

items.en: Latin baro meant a man or a soldier; its accusative was baronem.
items.cn: 拉丁语 baro 意为「人、战士」，宾格为 baronem。

items.en: Old French baron named a nobleman or a royal tenant.
items.cn: 古法语 baron 指贵族或国王的封臣。

items.en: English took baron for a lord holding land directly from the king.
items.cn: 英语借入 baron，指直接从国王手中领有土地的领主。

items.en: Baron settled as the lowest rank of the peerage.
items.cn: baron 固定为贵族中最低的一级男爵。

items.en: Oil baron and media baron named a magnate who rules a trade.
items.cn: oil baron 与 media baron 指主宰某个行业的大亨。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bar- and the same sound as barren; the near-meaning group lists other ranks and magnates.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar-，且与 barren 同音；近义组列出其他爵位与大亨。

entries.definition: the lands or rank of a baron
a British rank equal to count
a rank between earl and baron
a person of great power in a trade

normalIntro.en: Baron climbs from a free warrior to a royal tenant to a peer, then jumps to an oil magnate.
normalIntro.cn: baron 从自由战士升到国王封臣再到男爵，最后跳指石油大亨。

normal.en: Baron and barren sound identical but mean very different things.
normal.cn: baron 与 barren 读音相同，意思却完全不同。

normal.en: -ess gives baroness, -et gives baronet, -y gives barony.
normal.cn: -ess 构成 baroness，-et 构成 baronet，-y 构成 barony。

normal.en: A baronet is below a baron and is not a peer.
normal.cn: 准男爵低于男爵，且不属于贵族院成员。

normal.en: An oil baron or media baron rules a trade, not a valley.
normal.cn: oil baron 或 media baron 主宰一个行业，不是一片山谷。

normal.en: Robber baron first meant a lord who taxed every passing boat.
normal.cn: robber baron 原指对每艘过路船征税的领主。

abstract.en: See a warrior kneeling to receive a sealed charter of land.
abstract.cn: 想象一名战士跪下接受一纸封地特许状。

abstract.en: See a long table of peers, the baron seated at the lowest end.
abstract.cn: 想象贵族长桌，男爵坐在最末一端。

abstract.en: See an oil derrick beside a portrait in a heavy gold frame.
abstract.cn: 想象一座石油井架旁挂着镶金框的肖像。

examples.en: The baron owned half the valley and every mill in it.
examples.cn: 这位男爵拥有半个山谷和谷中每一座磨坊。

examples.en: The oil baron bought the railway to move his own crude.
examples.cn: 那位石油大亨买下铁路来运自己的原油。

examples.en: She was created a baroness in her own right.
examples.cn: 她凭自身功绩受封为女男爵。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「巴伦」——「巴」结国王的「伦」敦贵族，就是男爵；注意它与 barren（贫瘠的）读音完全相同，别把男爵的封地写成荒地。

root: 源自古法语 baron「贵族、战士」，追溯至晚期拉丁语 baro「人、战士」（宾格 baronem），或出自法兰克语 baro「自由人」；本指国王直属封臣，后定为贵族最低一级男爵，再引申为工业巨头。

sensesIntro.en: A feudal lord, a modern peer and an oil magnate can all be a baron.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个封建领主、一位现代贵族和一位石油大亨，都可以是 baron。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a warrior kneeling to receive a sealed charter of land.
core.cn: 核心意象：战士跪着接过一纸封地特许状。

intro.en: Baron takes -ess, -et, -y and -ial to build its whole family of rank words.
intro.cn: baron 加 -ess、-et、-y、-ial，构成整个爵位词族。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin baro, a man or soldier, is the root behind baron and baronial.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 baro「人、战士」是 baron 与 baronial 背后的词根。

items.example: a baroness in her own right
items.exampleCN: 凭自身功绩受封的女男爵

definition_zh: 形容词：巴洛克风格的（十七世纪繁复华丽）；过度雕琢的。名词：巴洛克风格；巴洛克时期（音乐约1600至1750）
definition_en: of the ornate seventeenth-century style in art and music; the style or period itself; excessively ornate or convoluted
core_image: 一颗长歪的珍珠，和一片堆满金饰曲线的顶棚
scene: 教堂顶棚满是金饰与曲线，导游说这是十七世纪的手笔。The ceiling is baroque, all curves and gold leaf.
sceneCN: 这里 baroque 是「巴洛克风格的」（第 1 个义项：十七世纪那种繁复华丽的艺术风格）；句意是这顶棚是巴洛克式的，满是曲线与金箔。

pos.zh: 形容词：巴洛克风格的；繁复矫饰的
名词：巴洛克风格；巴洛克时期

collocations.zh: 巴洛克小提琴（古乐演奏）

forms.label: 形容词原级（无屈折变化）

derivatives.zh: 形容词：洛可可式的，巴洛克之后的纤巧风格
名词：风格主义，巴洛克之前的手法主义
形容词：装饰华丽的
名词：明暗对照法

senses.title: The ornate style
senses.definition: of the elaborate, dramatic style of seventeenth-century art and architecture
senses.definitionCN: 属于十七世纪艺术与建筑那种繁复而富戏剧性的风格
senses.example: The ceiling is baroque, all curves and gold leaf.
senses.exampleCN: 这顶棚是巴洛克式的，满是曲线与金箔。
senses.why: French baroque meant bizarre; critics turned the insult into a style label.
senses.whyCN: 法语 baroque 本指「怪异」；批评家把这个贬称变成了风格标签。

senses.title: The music period
senses.definition: the period of European music from about 1600 to 1750
senses.definitionCN: 约 1600 至 1750 年的欧洲音乐时期
senses.example: They played baroque music on gut-strung violins.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用羊肠弦小提琴演奏巴洛克音乐。
senses.why: The style label was extended to the whole age that produced it.
senses.whyCN: 风格标签被扩展到产生它的整个时代。

senses.title: The style as a noun
senses.definition: the baroque style or period itself, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 巴洛克风格或时期本身，用作名词
senses.example: The palace is a textbook example of the baroque.
senses.exampleCN: 这座宫殿是巴洛克风格的教科书式范例。
senses.why: English lets the adjective stand as a noun with no ending added.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许形容词不加词尾直接作名词。

senses.title: Overdone and convoluted
senses.definition: excessively ornate, elaborate or tangled in style
senses.definitionCN: 风格上过度雕琢、繁复或纠缠不清
senses.example: His baroque prose hid a very simple argument.
senses.exampleCN: 他那繁复矫饰的文风掩盖了一个极简单的论点。
senses.why: A crooked pearl became a metaphor for anything twisted out of proportion.
senses.whyCN: 歪珍珠成了比喻，指任何扭曲失度的东西。

senses.title: Historical performance
senses.definition: in baroque violin or baroque pitch, the instruments and tuning of that age
senses.definitionCN: 用于 baroque violin、baroque pitch 等，指该时代的乐器与定音
senses.example: The baroque violin uses gut strings and a lower pitch.
senses.exampleCN: 巴洛克小提琴用羊肠弦，音高也更低。
senses.why: Period performance borrowed the style name for its instruments and tuning.
senses.whyCN: 古乐演奏借风格之名指称其乐器与定音。

intro.en: Baroque starts as a crooked pearl and ends as a style with too much gold on it.
intro.cn: baroque 从一颗歪珍珠出发，最后变成堆满金饰的风格。

items.en: Baroco was the medieval mnemonic for a convoluted syllogism; some trace the pearl word to it.
items.cn: Baroco 是中世纪逻辑学里一个绕口三段论的助记名；有人把「歪珠」一词追溯到它。

items.en: Portuguese barroco named an irregular, misshapen pearl.
items.cn: 葡萄牙语 barroco 指形状不规则的歪珍珠。

items.en: French baroque meant irregular, then bizarre or over-ornate.
items.cn: 法语 baroque 先指「不规则」，后指「怪异、过度装饰」。

items.en: English took it for odd, extravagantly decorated taste.
items.cn: 英语借入，指趣味怪诞、装饰过度。

items.en: Critics named the ornate seventeenth-century style baroque.
items.cn: 艺术史家把十七世纪那种繁复风格命名为巴洛克。

items.en: Today it is a period noun and an adjective for anything overdone.
items.cn: 今天它既是时期名词，也形容任何过度雕琢之物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bar-; the near-meaning group lists neighbouring styles and words for excess.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar-；近义组列出相邻风格与表示「过度」的词。

entries.definition: the lowest rank of the peerage
the male voice between tenor and bass
an eighteenth-century style of light ornament

normalIntro.en: Baroque names a crooked pearl first, then a century of gilded curves.
normalIntro.cn: baroque 先指一颗歪珍珠，再指一个满是镀金曲线的世纪。

normal.en: Portuguese barroco meant an irregular pearl, not a style.
normal.cn: 葡萄牙语 barroco 本指歪珍珠，不是一种风格。

normal.en: The music period runs roughly from 1600 to 1750.
normal.cn: 巴洛克音乐时期大致从 1600 年到 1750 年。

normal.en: As an adjective it can praise or blame: ornate, or overdone.
normal.cn: 作形容词可褒可贬：华丽，或过度雕琢。

normal.en: Rococo follows baroque and is lighter and more playful.
normal.cn: rococo 继 baroque 之后，更轻盈、更俏皮。

normal.en: Baroque violin means gut strings and lower pitch, not modern setup.
normal.cn: baroque violin 指羊肠弦与较低音高，不是现代配置。

abstract.en: See a pearl that grew lopsided inside its shell.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗在贝壳里长歪了的珍珠。

abstract.en: See a ceiling covered in gilded curves and plaster clouds.
abstract.cn: 想象顶棚布满镀金曲线与灰泥云朵。

abstract.en: See a sentence so tangled that the reader loses the thread.
abstract.cn: 想象一个句子绕得让读者找不到主线。

examples.en: The ceiling is baroque, all curves and gold leaf.
examples.cn: 这顶棚是巴洛克式的，满是曲线与金箔。

examples.en: They played baroque music on gut-strung violins.
examples.cn: 他们用羊肠弦小提琴演奏巴洛克音乐。

examples.en: His baroque prose hid a very simple argument.
examples.cn: 他那繁复矫饰的文风掩盖了一个极简单的论点。

dict_mnemonic.text: 葡萄牙语 barroco「不规则的珍珠」到法语 baroque「怪异」，再到十七世纪那种堆满曲线与金饰的风格；珍珠歪了叫 baroque，文章绕了也叫 baroque。

root: 源自葡萄牙语 barroco「形状不规则的珍珠」，经法语 baroque「怪异、不规则」进入英语；十八世纪指趣味怪诞，十九世纪被艺术史家用来命名十七世纪那种繁复华丽的风格，再引申为「过度雕琢的」。

sensesIntro.en: A pearl, a ceiling, a musical period and a tangled sentence can all be baroque.
sensesIntro.cn: 一颗珍珠、一片顶棚、一个音乐时期和一个绕口的句子，都可以是 baroque。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pearl that grew lopsided inside its shell.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗在贝壳里长歪了的珍珠。

intro.en: Baroque is a Portuguese loan, so its relatives come from the ornament vocabulary: rococo, ornate, grotesque.
intro.cn: baroque 是葡萄牙语借词，其亲属来自装饰词汇：rococo、ornate、grotesque。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ornamentum family supplies ornate and ornament, the words that describe baroque excess.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ornamentum 词族提供 ornate 与 ornament，正是描述巴洛克式过度的词。

definition_zh: 名词：弹幕射击，火力网；（英式）拦河坝，堰；一连串密集袭来（质问、批评等）；阻塞气球
definition_en: a curtain of artillery fire; a weir or dam across a river; a heavy continuous flood of questions or criticism; a barrage balloon
core_image: 一道低堰拦住河水，一排炮弹横着压过战场
scene: 记者会刚开场，问题就从四面八方压过来，发言人几乎插不上话。The minister faced a barrage of questions about the missing funds.
sceneCN: 这里 barrage 是「一连串；密集袭来」（第 3 个义项：像炮火一样密集压来的事物）；句意是部长面对关于失踪资金的一连串质问。

pos.zh: 名词：弹幕；拦河坝；一连串

derivatives.zh: 名词：障碍物，同出法语 barre
名词：路障，同出法语 barr- 词族
动词：拦住，法语 barrer 的英语对应

senses.title: The curtain of fire
senses.definition: a continuous curtain of artillery fire laid across a target area
senses.definitionCN: 横铺在目标区域上的一片持续炮火
senses.example: A creeping barrage walked ahead of the advancing infantry.
senses.exampleCN: 徐进弹幕在推进的步兵前方逐步延伸。
senses.why: French barrer meant to bar; a barrage bars the enemy with a wall of shells.
senses.whyCN: 法语 barrer 意为「拦住」；barrage 就是用一墙炮弹拦住敌人。

senses.title: The river weir
senses.definition: a barrier built across a river to hold back or divert water
senses.definitionCN: 横拦河流以蓄水或导流的坝或堰
senses.example: The barrage across the estuary generates tidal power.
senses.exampleCN: 河口那道拦河坝用来发潮汐电。
senses.why: This is the older English sense, borrowed from French barrage in 1859.
senses.whyCN: 这是英语较早的一义，1859 年从法语 barrage 借入。

senses.title: A flood of questions
senses.definition: a heavy continuous series of questions, criticism or blows
senses.definitionCN: 密集连续的一连串质问、批评或打击
senses.example: The minister faced a barrage of questions about the missing funds.
senses.exampleCN: 部长面对关于失踪资金的一连串质问。
senses.why: Anything arriving like a curtain of shells is called a barrage.
senses.whyCN: 任何像炮弹幕一样压来的事物都叫 barrage。

senses.title: The barrage balloon
senses.definition: a tethered balloon flown in a net to deter low-flying aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 系留在网中、用以阻挡低飞飞机的气球
senses.example: A barrage balloon hung above the bridge all night.
senses.exampleCN: 一只阻塞气球整夜悬在桥上方。
senses.why: The balloon bars the air as the weir bars the water.
senses.whyCN: 气球拦住天空，正如堰拦住河水。

senses.title: The creeping barrage
senses.definition: artillery fire that lifts forward in steps ahead of advancing troops
senses.definitionCN: 随步兵推进而逐段向前延伸的炮火
senses.example: The creeping barrage lifted fifty metres every two minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 徐进弹幕每两分钟向前延伸五十米。
senses.why: The curtain idea became a moving curtain that walks with the infantry.
senses.whyCN: 「一片」的想法变成会随步兵移动的「一片」。

intro.en: Barrage is a bar across a river, then a bar of fire across a battlefield.
intro.cn: barrage 先是横拦河流的坝，再是横拦战场的炮火。

items.en: Barre meant a bar or a barrier across a way.
items.cn: barre 意为横木，或挡住去路的障碍。

items.en: Barrer meant to bar or to block, the verb behind barrage.
items.cn: barrer 意为「拦住、堵住」，是 barrage 背后的动词。

items.en: French barrage named a dam or weir built across a river.
items.cn: 法语 barrage 指横拦河流的坝或堰。

items.en: English borrowed the river-dam sense first.
items.cn: 英语先借入「拦河坝」这一义。

items.en: In the First World War barrage became a curtain of artillery fire.
items.cn: 一战中 barrage 转指一片炮火弹幕。

items.en: Barrage balloons, and a barrage of questions, extend the curtain idea.
items.cn: 阻塞气球与「一连串问题」都延续了「密集一片」的想法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bar- or the French -age; the near-meaning group gives volleys and weirs.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar- 或法语 -age；近义组是「齐射」与「堰」的词。

abstract.en: See shells falling in a line that walks forward across a field.
abstract.cn: 想象炮弹排成一条线，缓缓向前推进过田野。

dict_mnemonic.text: barr（拦）＋ -age（行为或结果）＝「拦出一片」：先是拦河的坝，再是拦路的炮火弹幕，最后是拦住你的一连串问题；与 garage（车库）同尾，别读错。

root: 源自法语 barrage「拦河坝」，由 barrer「拦住」加 -age 构成，追溯至古法语 barre「横木」；1859 年英语先取「堰」义，1915 年一战中转为「弹幕射击」，再引申为「一连串密集袭来」。

sensesIntro.en: A weir, a curtain of shells, a balloon net and a flood of questions are all a barrage.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a low weir holding back a wall of water.

latinIntro.en: Vulgar Latin barra, a bar, is the root behind the whole blocking family.

items.meaning: a bar across, then a curtain

definition_zh: 桶；一桶之量；桶状物；飞速行进
definition_en: a large round container with curved sides, or to move very fast
core_image: 酒窖里一排弧肚木桶
scene: 酒窖里飘着木头的味道。They rolled the barrel down to the cellar.
sceneCN: 这里 barrel 是「桶」（第 1 个义项：侧面鼓起的圆形大容器）；句意是他们把桶滚进地窖。

derivatives.zh: 由 barrel 加 -ful 构成，义为「一桶之量」
由 barrel 加 -ed 构成，义为「装有桶的；桶状的」

senses.title: A round container
senses.definition: a large round container with a flat top and bottom and curved sides
senses.definitionCN: 上下平、侧面鼓起的圆形大容器
senses.example: They rolled the barrel down to the cellar.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把桶滚进地窖。
senses.why: Barrel came from Old French baril, a cask, and its curved wooden staves make it easy to roll.
senses.whyCN: barrel 来自古法语 baril「木桶」，弧形木板使它便于滚动。

senses.title: A barrel's amount
senses.definition: the amount that a barrel holds, used as a unit for oil
senses.definitionCN: 一只桶所装的量，常用作石油的计量单位
senses.example: The price of a barrel of oil rose sharply.
senses.exampleCN: 一桶石油的价格大幅上涨。
senses.why: Because the container was a standard size, its name became a unit of measure.
senses.whyCN: 因为容器容量固定，它的名称就成了计量单位。

senses.title: To move very fast
senses.definition: to move quickly and without control
senses.definitionCN: 快速且难以控制地移动
senses.example: The truck barreled down the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 卡车冲下山坡。
senses.why: A rolling barrel gathers speed, so the verb pictures fast, unchecked movement.
senses.whyCN: 滚动的木桶会越滚越快，所以动词描绘的是快速而失控的运动。

items.en: barrel became a unit for beer and oil.

items.en: the verb meant to roll fast.

items.en: barrel remains a common measure.
items.cn: 如今 barrel 仍是常用计量词。

normal.en: The plural is barrels.

normal.en: Oil is sold by the barrel.

normal.en: Over a barrel means having no choice.

normal.en: The verb barreled means moved very fast.

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: BAR-rel.

abstract.en: See curved wooden staves bound by rings.
abstract.cn: 想象弧形木板被铁箍捆住。

abstract.en: See a barrel rolling down a ramp.
abstract.cn: 想象一只桶沿斜坡滚下。

abstract.en: See oil dripping from a tap.
abstract.cn: 想象油从龙头滴下。

examples.en: They rolled the barrel down to the cellar.
examples.cn: 他们把桶滚进地窖。

examples.cn: 一桶石油的价格大幅上涨。

sensesIntro.en: The container, the amount it holds and its rolling speed are one round object.
sensesIntro.cn: 容器、它所装的量以及滚动的速度，都围绕同一个圆形物。

definition_zh: 贫瘠的；不结果实的；不孕的；无益的
definition_en: land that bears no crops; women or animals that bear no young; efforts that yield nothing
core_image: 犁开一圈却只翻起石头的田地
scene: 垦荒者跪在地上抓起一把灰白色碎土。Nothing grows in this barren soil.
sceneCN: 这里 barren 指「贫瘠的」（第 1 个义项：不生五谷之地）；句意：这片贫瘠的土壤寸草不生。

forms.label: 形容词原级（无屈折变化）

derivatives.zh: 贫瘠；不孕育（barren + -ness）
贫瘠地；徒劳地（barren + -ly）

senses.title: Land that bears no crops
senses.definition: producing little or no vegetation
senses.definitionCN: 几乎不生草木的
senses.example: Sheep nibbled at barren hillsides.
senses.exampleCN: 羊群啃食着荒瘠的山坡。
senses.why: The root meant bare, sterile: nothing clings to it.
senses.whyCN: 词根义为「光秃、不生」：什么也长不住。

senses.title: Unable to bear young
senses.definition: of women or animals, not producing offspring
senses.definitionCN: 指妇女或动物不能生育
senses.example: In old tales, a barren queen was a tragedy.
senses.exampleCN: 在古老传说里，无嗣的王后是一场悲剧。
senses.why: What is true of fields is said of wombs.
senses.whyCN: 田地之语移用于子嗣。

senses.title: Plants that bear no fruit
senses.definition: of plants, not producing fruit or seed
senses.definitionCN: 指植物不结果实或种子
senses.example: The orchard's barren trees were cut down.
senses.exampleCN: 果园里不结果的树被砍掉了。
senses.why: The sterile field extends to the single tree.
senses.whyCN: 瘠土之义延及单株之树。

senses.title: Empty of interest or content
senses.definition: dull, without interest or value
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏趣味或价值
senses.example: The novel is stylish but barren of ideas.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说时髦却思想贫乏。
senses.why: Nothing grows in a mind so stripped.
senses.whyCN: 被剥光的心田同样寸草不生。

senses.title: Without results
senses.definition: producing no useful result
senses.definitionCN: 不产生任何有用结果
senses.example: Their search proved barren.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的搜寻一无所获。
senses.why: Effort spent on sterile ground feeds no one.
senses.whyCN: 瘠土上的汗水养不活人。

senses.title: Stripped or bare appearance
senses.definition: bare, as a landscape without shelter or ornament
senses.definitionCN: 指景色光秃、无遮无饰
senses.example: Barren rocks ran down to the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 光秃的岩石直延伸入海。
senses.why: The visual bareness is the root's first face.
senses.whyCN: 视觉上的光秃正是词根的第一面孔。

senses.title: The noun: a stretch of barren land
senses.definition: barrens, an area of unproductive land
senses.definitionCN: 指荒瘠地带，常用复数 barrens
senses.example: Caribou cross the barrens each autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 驯鹿每年秋天穿越荒原。
senses.why: The adjective hardened into a place name.
senses.whyCN: 形容词固化成地名。

senses.title: Barren of
senses.definition: completely lacking something
senses.definitionCN: 全然缺乏某物
senses.example: The report is barren of any evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 报告没有任何证据。
senses.why: Of-names what the sterile ground does not hold.
senses.whyCN: of 点名瘠土所无之物。

intro.en: Barren comes from Old French barain, of a woman or beast, barren, of uncertain deeper origin; some link it to a Vulgar Latin form from a Celtic or Germanic root meaning bare.
intro.cn: barren 出自古法语 barain「（女子或牲畜）不孕的」，更深来源不确定；一说与「光秃」义的通俗拉丁或凯尔特、日耳曼词根有关。

items.en: Etymologists mark the deeper root as unknown.
items.cn: 词源学家标记其更深词根不明。

items.en: A proposed Vulgar Latin brachus, sterile, has been suggested.
items.cn: 一说经通俗拉丁语 brachus「不生的」。

items.en: barain described sterile women, animals, and land.
items.cn: 古法语 barain 形容不孕者与瘠地。

items.en: English took the word with both the womb and the field senses.
items.cn: 英语借入时兼有子嗣与田地二义。

items.en: The figurative senses of emptiness and futility now dominate writing.
items.cn: 如今「空洞、徒劳」的比喻义主导书面语。

note.en: Group one holds the barren family and look-alikes; group two holds the fertility field.
note.cn: 第一组收 barren 词族与形近词；第二组收「生育」义场。

entries.definition: the lands of a baron; from baron, no kin to barren.
entries.definitionCN: 男爵领地；出 baron，词源无关。

entries.definition: a farm building; Old English bern, from bere, barley.
entries.definitionCN: 谷仓；出古英语 bern，源于「大麦」，词源无关。

entries.definition: unable to produce young; free from life.

entries.definitionCN: 肥沃的；多产的；反义对照。

normalIntro.en: barren sounds like bare plus nothing: bare ground where nothing grows.
normalIntro.cn: barren 听来像 bare 加空无：寸草不生的光地。

normal.en: Root: Old French barain, sterile.
normal.cn: 词根：古法语 barain「不生的」。

normal.en: Deeper origin: uncertain.
normal.cn: 更早词源：不确定。

normal.en: Noun: the barrens, bleak uplands.
normal.cn: 名词：the barrens，荒原。

normal.en: Pair: barren of ideas.
normal.cn: 搭配：barren of ideas，思想贫乏。

normal.en: Kin: barrenness, barrenly.
normal.cn: 同族：barrenness、barrenly。

abstract.en: See furrows of stone, not of soil.
abstract.cn: 看那翻出来的不是土，是石头。

abstract.en: Barren is a cradle with no child in it.
abstract.cn: barren 是一只空摇篮。

abstract.en: Hear the wind pass over nothing.
abstract.cn: 听风从一无所有之上掠过。

examples.en: Years of drought left the plateau barren.
examples.cn: 连年干旱使高原沦为荒地。

examples.en: The experiments proved barren of breakthroughs.
examples.cn: 这些实验未能带来突破。

examples.en: A barren winter tree scratched at the window.
examples.cn: 冬日秃树的枝桠刮擦着窗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「白人」——白花花一片人烟绝迹，正是不毛之地

root: 出自古法语 barain「不生的、不孕的」（一说经通俗拉丁语，更早来源不确定）；英语承其「不生育」与「不毛」二义，并引申出「空洞、徒劳」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses circle one empty field: sterile soil, infertile womb, fruitless tree, dull mind, failed effort, bare view, the noun barrens, and barren of.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕一片空田：瘠土、不孕、不结果、空洞、徒劳、光秃、名词瘠地与 barren of 结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ground where nothing will take root.
core.cn: 核心意象：寸草不生、什么都扎不下根的地。

branches.en: Bare land and bare view are the visible start.
branches.cn: 瘠土与光秃是可见的起点。

branches.en: Womb and tree borrow the field's sterility.
branches.cn: 子嗣与果树借田地之瘠。

branches.en: A dull page is a field with no crop.
branches.cn: 乏味的书页是不长庄稼的田。

branches.en: Effort and lacking both measure the emptiness.
branches.cn: 徒劳与缺乏同量此空无。

branches.en: The barrens name the emptiness on maps.
branches.cn: the barrens 把空无写上地图。

intro.en: The barren family is narrow, an adjective with its adverb and noun; its force lies in phrase patterns.
intro.cn: barren 词族狭小，仅形容词与副词、名词；力量在短语之中。

latinIntro.en: No certain Latin kin; the trail fades before Latin, so the Latin table stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 无确证的拉丁同源词，词线在拉丁语前中断，拉丁同族表留空。

definition_en: the state of being barren: land that bears nothing, inability to produce young, or emptiness of ideas and results
core_image: 灰白干裂的土地，指缝里一颗种子也没有
scene: 垦荒者抓起一把灰白的土，指缝里什么也没有留下。The barrenness of the soil defeated every farmer who tried it.
sceneCN: 这里 barrenness 是「贫瘠；不毛」（第 1 个义项：土地长不出东西的状态）；句意是土壤的贫瘠挫败了每一个尝试耕种的人。

senses.title: Land that bears nothing
senses.definition: the state of soil that produces no crops
senses.definitionCN: 土地长不出庄稼的状态
senses.example: The barrenness of the soil defeated every farmer who tried it.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤的贫瘠挫败了每一个尝试耕种的人。
senses.why: -ness freezes the adjective barren into a name for the condition itself.
senses.whyCN: -ness 把形容词 barren 凝固成「这种状态」的名字。

senses.title: Inability to bear young
senses.definition: the state of being unable to produce offspring
senses.definitionCN: 不能生育后代的状态
senses.example: The old records speak of the barrenness of the queen.
senses.exampleCN: 旧档案提到那位王后未能生育。
senses.why: The field sense transferred to the womb, and -ness names the condition.
senses.whyCN: 「田地」义转指「子宫」，-ness 把这种状况命名为词。

senses.title: Emptiness of content
senses.definition: the state of having no ideas or substance
senses.definitionCN: 没有想法或实质的状态
senses.example: Critics complained of the barrenness of his later novels.
senses.exampleCN: 批评家抱怨他后期小说内容空洞。
senses.why: A page with no crop is barren, so its emptiness is barrenness.
senses.whyCN: 不长庄稼的书页是 barren 的，其空无便是 barrenness。

senses.title: Fruitlessness of effort
senses.definition: the state of yielding no result
senses.definitionCN: 不产生任何结果的状态
senses.example: The barrenness of their search discouraged the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 一无所获的搜寻令全队灰心。
senses.why: Effort that bears no fruit shares the field metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 不结果的努力共用同一个「田地」比喻。

senses.title: Bare, stripped appearance
senses.definition: the state of a landscape stripped of vegetation
senses.definitionCN: 地貌寸草不生、光秃裸露的状态
senses.example: The barrenness of the view matched the grey sky.
senses.exampleCN: 那片荒秃的景色与灰色的天空相称。
senses.why: Barren also means bare to the eye, and -ness names that bareness.
senses.whyCN: barren 也指「肉眼可见的光秃」，-ness 把这种光秃命名为词。

intro.en: Barrenness is barren frozen into a noun by the Old English suffix -ness.
intro.cn: barrenness 是古英语后缀 -ness 把 barren 冻成的名词。

items.en: The Germanic suffix -nes turned adjectives into nouns of state.
items.cn: 日耳曼语后缀 -nes 把形容词变成表示状态的名词。

items.en: A proposed source brachus meant fallow or sterile land.
items.cn: 拟构词源 brachus 意为休耕或贫瘠之地。

items.en: Old French baraigne meant sterile, of land or of womb.
items.cn: 古法语 baraigne 意为「不生育的」，指土地或子宫。

items.en: English took barren for land that bears nothing.
items.cn: 英语借入 barren，指长不出东西的土地。

items.en: Barren plus -ness named the state itself.
items.cn: barren 加 -ness，把「贫瘠」这件事本身命名为词。

items.en: Barrenness now covers soil, womb and empty writing alike.
items.cn: 今天 barrenness 同样可用于土壤、子嗣与空洞的文字。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bar- or -ness; the near-meaning group gives other state nouns of emptiness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bar- 或 -ness；近义组是其他表示「空无」的状态名词。

normalIntro.en: Barrenness is not a bare field but the state of being bare.
normalIntro.cn: barrenness 不是「一块荒地」，而是「荒」这种状态。

normal.en: -ness turns an adjective into a state noun, as kindness from kind.
normal.cn: -ness 把形容词变成状态名词，正如 kind 变 kindness。

normal.en: Barren describes the field; barrenness names the condition.
normal.cn: barren 描述那块地，barrenness 指称那种状态。

normal.en: It is usually uncountable, as in the barrenness of the soil.
normal.cn: 它通常不可数，例如 the barrenness of the soil。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with baroness, a female baron.
normal.cn: 别与 baroness（女男爵）混淆。

normal.en: The same suffix gives sterility from sterile and aridity from arid.
normal.cn: 同类后缀构成 sterility（来自 sterile）与 aridity（来自 arid）。

abstract.cn: 想象灰白干裂的土地，里面一颗种子也没有。

abstract.en: See an empty cradle in a silent room.
abstract.cn: 想象安静房间里一只空摇篮。

abstract.en: See a page of beautiful sentences with no idea underneath.
abstract.cn: 想象一页漂亮句子，底下却没有任何想法。

examples.en: The barrenness of the soil defeated every farmer who tried it.
examples.cn: 土壤的贫瘠挫败了每一个尝试耕种的人。

examples.en: Critics complained of the barrenness of his later novels.
examples.cn: 批评家抱怨他后期小说内容空洞。

examples.en: Years of drought increased the barrenness of the plateau.
examples.cn: 连年干旱加剧了高原的荒芜。

dict_mnemonic.text: barren（贫瘠的）＋ -ness（…的状态）＝贫瘠这件事本身；形容词 barren 说「地是荒的」，名词 barrenness 说「荒是一种状态」；别和 baroness（女男爵）听混。

root: 由形容词 barren「贫瘠的、不生育的」加古英语名词后缀 -ness「…的状态」构成；barren 经古法语 baraigne 进入英语，-ness 则把性质凝固成抽象名词，指土地、子嗣或内容的「空无状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Soil, a womb, a page and an effort can all show barrenness.
sensesIntro.cn: 土壤、子嗣、书页与努力，都可以显出 barrenness。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cracked grey earth with no seed in it.
core.cn: 核心意象：灰白干裂的土地，里面一颗种子也没有。

intro.en: The suffix -ness builds barrenness, and -ity builds its cousins sterility and aridity.
intro.cn: 后缀 -ness 构成 barrenness，-ity 则构成它的近亲 sterility 与 aridity。

latinIntro.en: Vulgar Latin brachus, fallow land, is the proposed root behind barren.

abstract.cn: 想象日历上每天都划了叉。

abstract.en: See a scale weighing evidence.
abstract.cn: 想象天平在称量证据。

examples.en: The staff meet on a weekly basis.
examples.cn: 员工每周开一次会。

examples.en: The claim has no basis in fact.

examples.en: They judged the work on the basis of quality.

sensesIntro.en: A regular footing and a supporting reason are both what something stands on.

definition_zh: 低音；低音部；低音提琴；鲈鱼
definition_en: the lowest range of sound or voice; the low-frequency part of music; a food fish
core_image: 音响里让你胸口发麻的那层嗡鸣
scene: 调音师蹲在音箱后拧低频旋钮，地板随之轻颤。Turn down the bass before the neighbors complain.
sceneCN: 这里 bass 指「低音」（第 1 个义项：音乐低频部分）；句意：在邻居投诉前把低音关小。

senses.title: The low part of music
senses.definition: the lowest range of pitches in music
senses.definitionCN: 音乐中最低的音区
senses.example: The organ's bass shook the cathedral floor.
senses.exampleCN: 管风琴的低音震得教堂地板发颤。
senses.why: Latin bassus meant low; music took the word for the floor of sound.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 bassus 意为「低」；音乐取之指声音的地板。

senses.title: The lowest male voice
senses.definition: the deepest singing voice of a man
senses.definitionCN: 男声中最低沉的声部
senses.example: He sings bass in the choir.
senses.exampleCN: 他在唱诗班唱男低音。
senses.why: The lowest part of the vocal range keeps the word.
senses.whyCN: 人声音域之最低者沿用此词。

senses.title: Low-frequency instruments
senses.definition: instruments designed for low pitch, as the double bass
senses.definitionCN: 为低音而设的乐器，如低音提琴
senses.example: A double bass stood behind the cellist.
senses.exampleCN: 大提琴手身后立着一架低音提琴。
senses.why: Each instrument family places its low member here.
senses.whyCN: 各乐器家族的低音成员皆归此列。

senses.title: The fish
senses.definition: a food fish of fresh or sea water
senses.definitionCN: 淡水或海产的食用鱼
senses.example: They caught bass off the rocks.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在礁石外钓到鲈鱼。
senses.why: A different line: Old English bærs, perch, shortened to bass.
senses.whyCN: 另一词线：古英语 bærs「河鲈」缩略为 bass。

senses.title: Bass as amplifier power
senses.definition: strong low-frequency sound from speakers
senses.definitionCN: 音箱输出的强劲低频
senses.example: The car's bass rattled the windows.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车音响的低音震得车窗作响。
senses.why: Reproduction technology borrowed the musical word.
senses.whyCN: 放音技术借用音乐之词。

senses.title: Bass clef
senses.definition: the F clef used for low-pitched notation
senses.definitionCN: 标记低音的 F 谱号
senses.example: Left-hand piano parts are written in bass clef.
senses.exampleCN: 钢琴左手声部记于低音谱号。
senses.why: Notation needs a flag for the basement of music.
senses.whyCN: 乐谱需要一面标记「地下室」的旗。

senses.title: Bass in mixed ensembles
senses.definition: the foundational layer supporting harmony
senses.definitionCN: 支撑和声的基础层
senses.example: A good bass line holds the whole band together.
senses.exampleCN: 好的贝斯线能把整支乐队拢住。
senses.why: The bottom carries the building again.
senses.whyCN: 底层再度承托整座建筑。

senses.title: Bass guitar
senses.definition: the four-string electric instrument of popular music
senses.definitionCN: 流行乐中四弦电声低音乐器
senses.example: She switched from guitar to bass.
senses.exampleCN: 她从吉他转弹贝斯。
senses.why: Electric times gave the bass its own instrument.
senses.whyCN: 电声时代让低音有了专属乐器。

intro.en: Bass is a respelling of base, from Latin bassus, low; the fish bass is a separate word from Old English bærs, perch.

items.en: The root behind bassus meant short, low.
items.cn: bassus 背后词根意为短、低。

items.en: bassus meant low of stature or pitch.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bassus 指身矮或音低。

items.en: Italian basso carried the low voice into music.
items.cn: 意大利语 basso 把低音带入音乐。

items.en: English spelled the music word base, then adopted bass to tell it from base, foundation.
items.cn: 英语先拼作 base，后改拼 bass 以区别「基础」之 base。

items.en: The fish came from bærs, the perch, its b-r dropping out.
items.cn: 鲈鱼出 bærs「河鲈」，首音 b-r 脱落。

note.en: Group one holds the low family and look-alikes; group two holds the music-range field.

entries.definition: foundation or morally low; the spelling twin.

examples.en: Freshwater bass thrive in weedy lakes.
examples.cn: 淡水鲈鱼在水草繁茂的湖中繁衍。

examples.en: Her bass guitar anchored the rhythm section.
examples.cn: 她的贝斯撑住了整个节奏组。

branches.cn: 音域与人声钉住低音层。

branches.en: Old and electric instruments serve it.
branches.cn: 传统与电声乐器皆为其服务。

branches.en: Speakers and clefs carry it into rooms and scores.
branches.cn: 音箱与谱号把它带入房间与乐谱。

branches.en: The bass line is harmony's footing.
The fish swims in by spelling alone.

intro.cn: bass 词族在拼写处分岔：一支低鸣，一支游弋。

latinIntro.en: Latin bassus and Italian basso feed the music branch.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 bassus 与意大利 basso 喂养音乐一支。

senses.title: The orchestral part

abstract.en: See a long wooden tube folded back on itself.
abstract.cn: 想象一根长木管对折回来。

abstract.en: See two thin reeds vibrating against each other.
abstract.cn: 想象两片薄簧片彼此振动。

abstract.en: See the player at the back of the woodwind row, head bent to the reed.
abstract.cn: 想象乐手坐在木管组最后排，低头对着簧片。

examples.en: The bassoon entered quietly under the strings.
examples.cn: 大管在弦乐之下轻轻进入。

examples.en: She plays bassoon in the national youth orchestra.
examples.cn: 她在国家青年管弦乐团吹大管。

examples.en: The bassoon solo opened the second movement.
examples.cn: 大管独奏段开启了第二乐章。

dict_mnemonic.text: basso（低）＋ -one（大）＝「大低音乐器」：意大利语 bassone 经法语 basson 变成英语 bassoon；双簧片、长管身，是木管里的男低音，别和 balloon（气球）混。

root: 源自意大利语 bassone「大的低音乐器」，由 basso「低的」加指大后缀 -one 构成，经法语 basson 进入英语；指双簧片木管乐器大管，是双簧管族的低音乐器，contrabassoon 再低八度。

sensesIntro.en: An instrument, an orchestral part, a player and a tone colour can all be bassoon.
sensesIntro.cn: 一件乐器、一个声部、一位乐手和一种音色，都可以是 bassoon。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long wooden tube folded back on itself, two reeds buzzing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根对折的长木管，两片簧片嗡嗡振动。

intro.en: Bassoon is basso plus -one, and -ist and contra- extend it to players and lower doubles.
intro.cn: bassoon 由 basso 加 -one 构成，-ist 与 contra- 再把它扩展到演奏者与更低音的同类。

latinIntro.en: Latin bassus, low, is the root shared with bass, basso and the whole low-register family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bassus「低的」是与 bass、basso 及整个低音词族共享的词根。
